info.comment: Field is only completed if the project is staged otherwise it will be empty
info.description: Stage refers to Staged Capacity – how much Capacity the Customer will connect and when.  The customer may choose to bring on capacity in chunks to align with their build /commissioning program.  Staged contracts are also used when a customer may only be able to bring on a proportion of their total capacity at a particular point in time ahead of further reinforcement works being carried out, completion of which would allow the remaining Capacity onto the system.
info.title: Stage

info.comment: Field will state 0MW until the project is built and connected
info.description: Amount of capacity currently connected to the National Grid
info.title: MW Connected

info.comment: Field will state 0MW unless the capacity is due to increase or decrease
info.description: Amount of capacity contracted to connect or be removed at a future date
info.title: MW Increase / Decrease

info.description: Total amount of capacity contracted across all Stages
info.title: Cumulative Total Capacity (MW)

info.comment: Field will only include dates for future connections or increase/decreases to capacity, otherwise this field will be empty
info.description: Date on which Connection is contracted to be effective from
info.title: MW Effective From
